finding.risk: super_admin was included in password reset bypass logic
finding.impact: super_admin accounts could avoid the forced password reset path
finding.resolution: Only owner remains in backend and frontend password reset bypass logic.

audited_surfaces.result: owner-only bypass helper is used for login and session user payloads
initial_must_change_password_for_role() now returns true for super_admin and every non-owner role; role updates also recalculate the stored flag
requiresPasswordChange() only bypasses owner, so all non-owner roles route to /force-password-reset when the backend flag requires it
migration recalculates must_change_password to false for owner and true for all non-owner rows

remaining_super_admin_password_reset_ref.purpose: negative regression assertion that super_admin is not accepted as a frontend bypass

conclusion: No active super_admin password reset bypass remains in backend or frontend policy code.
